newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson shares rise to new high.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson shares rise to new high.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications firm LM Ericsson AB's shares rose 3.6 percent on Wednesday morning to a new high, driven by overseas buying.
At 1100 GMT Ericsson's shares were 7.5 crowns higher at 215.5 crowns.
"It is being driven by institutional buying from abroad but there is no particular reason for this," said one broker.
Another broker said the rise was not that surprising.
"The interesting thing is that Ericsson did so badly in the U.S. yesterday, not that the share is going well today," he said.
Rival Finnish firm Nokia traded at 284.5 markka, up 12.5.
U.S. firm Motorola's latest profit report is due on Thursday.
